verdict.rationale: The docs say OpenClaw "can use many LLM providers": you pick a provider, authenticate, and set a default model as `provider/model`. Community reports confirm Anthropic and Google provider options exist and are used (now limited to API access rather than consumer subscriptions). There is no evidence of switching models per agent or per conversation; multi-agent docs only mention separate workspaces, auth and sessions, not per-agent model selection. Missing for 10: per-agent and per-conversation model switching, explicit OpenRouter/OpenAI provider listing, a detailed provider catalog, and hands-on corroboration of multi-provider configuration.
